title: Choose the visual world for the Unswayed demo console
question: The roll assigned Blinded Trial. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Blinded Trial
options.lineage: double-blind trial kits, sealed randomisation envelopes, CONSORT flow diagrams
options.thesis: The demo runs as a two-arm trial: one arm reads the story, the other gets the sealed sample.
options.viewport: One pull request splits into two colour-owned arms, vermilion reads the description, ultramarine sees it sealed; verdict stamps land per arm, and a 90-cell blister pack shows 53 approved against 6.
options.risk: A medical metaphor can feel off-topic to CISOs if the labels stop speaking security.

options.label: Modular Colour Bars
options.thesis: Hard saturated bars physically cover the author's story wherever the gate looks.
options.case: Fuses well and reads from the back row, but it looks like a design festival more than a control a CISO would sign off.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.lineage: green-phosphor terminals in a midnight machine room
options.thesis: The whole demo prints itself as one glowing transcript.
options.case: The room knows it by heart, which is the problem: every security demo ships it, and one transcript column cannot hold two verdicts side by side.

options.label: Torn Billboard
options.lineage: Paris décollage, posters torn back to earlier layers
options.thesis: Tear the story away and the diff underneath is what gets judged.
options.case: The tear is the mechanism, but aged poster fragments cost legibility at projector distance.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark security dashboard: two panels side by side with red and green status chips.
canonCard.viewport: Description and diff on the left, reviewer and gate verdict cards on the right, a metrics row along the bottom.
